batch: Exodus Block 5 - The Tabernacle Constructed (Ex 35:1-40:38). THIN (largely fulfils the ch25-31 instructions). Reuse thin-block method: surface genuine spans (willing-heart payout, skill-to-teach, glory filling the tent), label construction honestly, don't force.

units.characteristics: the willing heart brings; the wise-hearted; Bezalel called and filled - and given to teach
units.gist: NARRATIVE/GEM(thin-rich) - after the calf, the offering for the tabernacle: everyone whose HEART (lev 35:5,21) STIRRED him and whose spirit was WILLING (nadav/nediv 35:21,22,29) brings; the WISE-HEARTED (chakham-lev 35:10,25,26) women spin; Bezalel CALLED (qara 35:30) by name, FILLED with the Spirit of God - WISDOM (chokmah), UNDERSTANDING (tevunah 35:31), KNOWLEDGE (daat), to DEVISE (chashav 35:32) designs - AND 'he has put in his HEART to TEACH' (35:34), he and Oholiab. The willing-heart PAYOUT of 25:2; skill-as-Spirit-filling (31:3) now extended to TEACHING others.

units.characteristics: the wise-hearted make; the people bring more than enough; Moses restrains them
units.gist: NARRATIVE/GEM(thin-rich) - Bezalel, Oholiab, and every WISE-HEARTED (chakham-lev 36:1,2,8) man in whom the LORD put WISDOM/UNDERSTANDING (chokmah/tevunah) work; the people keep bringing freewill offerings morning by morning, and the workers say 'the people bring MUCH MORE (ravah 36:5) than enough for the work'; so Moses gives command and they are RESTRAINED from bringing - the material was more than enough (36:6-7). THE willing-heart climax: generosity so great it must be stopped. Then the tabernacle itself made (mostly construction).

units.characteristics: the ark, table, lampstand, altars, court, materials tally (construction)
units.gist: CONSTRUCTION/THIN - Bezalel makes the ark, table, lampstand, incense altar, anointing oil (ch37); the bronze altar, the laver, the court, and the tally of metals used (ch38). Almost entirely making-detail: HEIGHT (qomah), PURE (tahor) gold, HOLY (qodesh) things, the SERVICE (avodah) work, the DEVISING (chashav) skill enacted. Near-empty of inner-being; capture the few spans, do not force meaning on dimensions or the materials-count.

units.characteristics: the priestly garments made; the exact obedience - 'as the LORD commanded Moses'
units.gist: CONSTRUCTION/THIN-note - the priestly garments made: the skilled DEVISING (chashav 39:3,8), the HOLY (qodesh) garments, PURE (tahor) gold, the SERVICE (avodah). The chapter's refrain, 7x: 'as the LORD had commanded Moses' - and at the end (39:32,42-43) 'thus all the work was finished... they had done it as the LORD commanded, so they had done it; and Moses blessed them'. Mostly construction; the genuine note is the EXACT OBEDIENCE (the contrast to the calf's disobedience) - fidelity in the making.

units.characteristics: the tabernacle raised; anointed and consecrated; the glory fills the tent - Exodus's close
units.gist: GEM - on the first day of the first year Moses RAISES the tabernacle, sets each thing in order (arakh 40:4), ANOINTS and CONSECRATES (qadash 40:9-13) the tent, furniture, and priests to make them HOLY (qodesh); does all 'as the LORD commanded'. Then the cloud covers the tent and the GLORY (kavod 40:34,35) of the LORD FILLS the tabernacle - so that Moses cannot enter; the cloud guiding all their journeys (40:36-38). EXODUS'S CLOSE: God comes to DWELL - the indwelling promised (29:45-46) realized, the TRUE dwelling after the calf's false one; the glory that filled Sinai now fills the tent among the people.
